maria: main CI turned red right after my PR merged (PR #5421). Smoke e2e kvalloc failing on GPU-1. Anyone owning that job?
ci-bot: pipeline main-smoke-gpu failed — step kvalloc-matrix (run 4827). Logs: https://ci.internal/runs/4827
devon: on it. can you paste the failing test log snippet?
maria: hmm tests were green locally. here's the tail:
```
E gpu alloc error: cudnnAlloc failed at allocator.cc:342
Test failed: test_kv_cache_consistency
```
ash: can we just rerun the stage? sometimes transient GPU flake.
sre-oncall: rerun queued: `/ci rerun --job kvalloc-matrix --run 4827` — will take ~2m
ci-bot: rerun started (job 4829)
devon: if rerun fails, we should bisect. try `git bisect start --first 8f3a2 --last HEAD` on main to narrow
maria: ack will stand by. if bisect points to my change I'll open revert
ci-bot: rerun failed — same test failing in 4829
devon: starting bisect now, will post candidate commit when found
ash: if bisect points to infra change, ping eng-infra-owners. also prep a revert PR just in case
devon: bisect result: culprit commit `d4c1b9f` (2026-03-17) — touches allocator flags; suspect quantization cache change
maria: that's in my PR's dependency chain (merged earlier). opening revert: #5428
sre-oncall: thanks. queued emergency revert, will watch for fallout :eyes:
maria: sorry all, will follow-up in PR and add a test case to reproduce locally :pray:
ash: thanks — update channel when revert lands
